name: Withering Purpurbloom
description: A flower, the leaves and petals of which look scorched and withered, that can often be seen in places where ash abounds.
fullDescription: A flower, the leaves and petals of which look scorched and withered, that can often be seen in places where ash abounds.\nFrom the name Purpurbloom, you would assume that their colors would be deeper and more vibrant. Yet even these flowers, once so cherished by the people of Cinder City, could not escape being tainted by the cankering shadow that enveloped their entire city. In the end, they too were consumed by the god's raging inferno. Even today, simply by observing their charred, desiccated leaves, one gets a vague sense of the all-engulfing power of that raging fire that once melted a city entire.
